data.name: Hemansh
data.gender_notes: Hemansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit 'Hem' meaning God and 'Ansh' meaning presence or form. Hemansh signifies the presence of God within. The name Hemansh carries the meaning “God's Treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine presence and blessings.
data.etymology: Hemansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
